title: Master STOL Drag: Moza AB6 FFB setup & controls for the CubCrafters XCub | MSFS
description:
Dial in your Moza AB6 direct drive base for the CubCrafters XCub in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

STOL Drag racing throws high-altitude speed out the window for a brutal 2,000-foot head-to-head sprint. The real danger isn't high bank angles—it's the extreme deceleration flare right before touchdown. Pitch up too aggressively to bleed speed and you risk an instant tip stall straight into the dirt, while the 180° ground pivot demands instant rudder and differential brake authority. In this guide, we map essential in-game controls and dial in Moza Cockpit force feedback telemetry—calibrating low-speed damping, tailwheel lock handling, and a 100% stall buffet—so your hands feel the stall onset before the gear touches down.

Want to skip manual slider adjustments? Download the ready-to-import profiles on the website:

🔗 Download FFB & Control Profiles: https://highintheflightsimsky.nl
